meta.title: BPO & Back Office Outsourcing Services | Outsourcing Group
meta.description: Professional BPO services: Contact Center, Digital Back Office, Data Management and Training. Outsource business processes and reduce costs.

hero.description1: Digital transformation requires structured, reliable, and scalable internal processes.
hero.description2: To support the company in managing data, documents, and operational activities, specific skills and dedicated resources are needed.
hero.description3: We integrate operational, technical, and analytical expertise.

assistenza-dedicata.name: Dedicated User Assistance
assistenza-dedicata.serviceDescription: We support your users in activations, configurations and use of digital services.
assistenza-dedicata.shortDescription: We support your users in activations, configurations and use of digital services.
assistenza-dedicata.detailDescription: We support your users in the activations, configurations and daily use of digital services. Our team handles every request competently and carefully, offering clear, timely, and personalized assistance. We accompany users throughout the operational journey, from understanding the service to resolving any difficulties, ensuring a smooth and uninterrupted experience.
assistenza-dedicata.functionalitySubtitle: Each request is handled by a dedicated operator, trained in customer services, following clear and measurable procedures.

item1.title: Understanding the digital service
item1.description: We help the user clearly understand what they are purchasing, what features are available and how to access them.

item2.title: Guided activations and configurations
item2.description: We support users in initial activations, custom configurations and technical settings, even in step-by-step mode.

item3.title: Technical-operational support
item3.description: We handle requests and technical issues related to the use of digital services, offering immediate solutions.

item4.title: Correct and safe use
item4.description: We accompany users in the compliant use of digital tools, reducing errors and improper behavior.

item5.title: Resolution of difficulties
item5.description: We intervene to unblock critical situations, guiding the user to resolution and ensuring continuity of the service.

item1.title: Digital services always operational
item1.description: Save on salaries, benefits and training thanks to a ready-made, certified team.

item2.title: No burden on internal departments
item2.description: We manage daily support, peaks and activations, without interruptions for your team.

assistenza-dedicata.detailedContentTitle: Support that simplifies the use of digital services

detailedContent.p1: With our dedicated support service, your users receive direct and personalized assistance to understand, configure and correctly use the digital tools provided by your company. We manage activations, accesses, operational difficulties, technical problems and any daily needs that may hinder the operation.
detailedContent.p2: The company maintains full control and governance of the digital service, while we manage all day-to-day operations. This allows internal departments - such as IT, HR, Compliance, or Digital Office - to focus on strategic activities without having to absorb continuous requests from users.
detailedContent.p3: The result is a digital service that is always functioning, compliant with company policies and used correctly by users, with support also available in English when needed.

contact-center.name: Contact Center
contact-center.serviceDescription: We manage all incoming client communication with structured multi-channel assistance.
contact-center.shortDescription: We manage all incoming client communication with structured multi-channel assistance.
contact-center.detailDescription: Structured multi-channel support to handle every request from your customers clearly, quickly and professionally. Each contact is tracked and managed to ensure maximum satisfaction.
contact-center.functionalitySubtitle: Each project starts from an analysis of the client's needs. We define the flows, train the team and activate the necessary channels.

item1.title: Unified multi-channel platform
item1.description: We manage all communications in one console: phone, email, chat, tickets and social.

item2.title: Complete traceability
item2.description: Each interaction is recorded and monitored, ensuring visibility into timing, outcomes, and volumes.

item3.title: SLAs guaranteed
item3.description: We respect defined response times, with periodic reports on operational performance.

item4.title: Integrated flow
item4.description: Entry takes place in the Contact Center and, if necessary, the request is addressed to the client's departments for completion.

item5.title: Trained operators
item5.description: Each operator is trained in the client's services, to ensure competent and consistent responses.

advantages.item1: Single clear and professional point of contact
advantages.item5: Consistency of responses across all channels
advantages.item6: Reduced internal workload for the company team

contact-center.detailedContentTitle: An integrated, fluid and always under control customer service

detailedContent.p1: We manage all incoming customer communication through a multi-channel model that includes phone, email, chat, social, tickets and digital platforms. Each request is taken over with quick, consistent and always traceable responses.
detailedContent.p2: Our Contact Center is the entry point for all communications: from here, requests are directed to Customer Care, which manages the relationship, and to Customer Service, which handles operational solutions.
detailedContent.p3: The full integration between Contact Center, Customer Care, and Customer Service ensures a seamless experience, uniform and of high quality, providing your users with a truly excellent Customer Experience.

outsourcing-back-office-digitale.name: Digital Back Office
outsourcing-back-office-digitale.serviceDescription: We provide a structured Digital Back Office service to manage operational activities related to digital services.
outsourcing-back-office-digitale.shortDescription: We provide a structured Digital Back Office service to manage operational activities related to digital services.
outsourcing-back-office-digitale.detailDescription: We support your digital processes through structured operational services, managed by qualified teams and with compliant procedures. Each activity is tracked, verified and completed according to defined SLAs.
outsourcing-back-office-digitale.functionalitySubtitle: The Outsourcing Group team manages the operational phases of digital services, from document verification to activation and release.

functionality.item1: Document checks for user onboarding and service activation.
functionality.item2: Identity checks through digital systems and compliant procedures.
functionality.item3: Validation of requirements (e.g. technical, regulatory or contractual requirements).
functionality.item4: Custom account, profile and settings configurations.
functionality.item5: On-demand activations with procedures provided by defined SLAs.
functionality.item6: Release of services with management from the beginning to the end of the practice.
functionality.item8: Any escalation to technical or advanced support departments.

outsourcing-back-office-digitale.advantagesTitle: Digital Back Office is ideal for companies that:

advantages.item3: Must ensure quality and compliance in processes
advantages.item4: Want to lighten the internal operational load
advantages.item5: Operate in regulated sectors or high-volume areas of practice

outsourcing-back-office-digitale.detailedContentTitle: An operational support that simplifies the management of digital services

detailedContent.p1: In the Digital Back Office, each phase must be managed in an orderly and consistent manner: document verifications, identity checks, requirement validation and activations require clear procedures and constant supervision.
detailedContent.p2: That is why we organize all activities into structured flows, with complete traceability and processing times defined by the agreed SLAs.
detailedContent.p3: We deal with operations that cannot be fully automated, ensuring precision and uniformity, even in the presence of high volumes or sensitive practices.
detailedContent.p4: The result is smoother management, less risk of error, and an internal team that can focus on strategic activities.

gestione-anagrafiche-clienti-outsourcing.name: Operational Management of Customer Data
gestione-anagrafiche-clienti-outsourcing.serviceDescription: We manage the creation and alignment of customer data in your business systems.
gestione-anagrafiche-clienti-outsourcing.shortDescription: We manage the creation and alignment of customer data in your business systems.
gestione-anagrafiche-clienti-outsourcing.detailDescription: We organize and manage all operational activities related to customer data: from registry creation to update management, with complete traceability and regulatory compliance.
gestione-anagrafiche-clienti-outsourcing.functionalitySubtitle: Each administrative process is managed with clear, traceable workflows that comply with current legislation.

item1.title: Standardized procedures
item1.description: Each activity follows documented, verifiable and replicable procedures to ensure quality and consistency.

item2.title: Complete traceability
item2.description: All operations (creations, changes, deletions) are tracked and documented to ensure compliance.

item3.title: Integration with your systems
item3.description: We work directly on CRM, management and corporate databases, without interruptions in flows.

item4.title: Qualified supervision
item4.description: Operators trained in specific regulations and procedures of the customer's industry.

item5.title: Continuous quality controls
item5.description: We perform constant checks on data and practices to intercept and correct errors before they impact.

advantages.item1: Elimination of registry and administrative errors
advantages.item2: Drastic reduction of internal management time
advantages.item4: Best experience for the end customer
advantages.item5: Control of economic flows and administrative practices
advantages.item7: Immediate scalability in case of volume increase

gestione-anagrafiche-clienti-outsourcing.detailedContentTitle: An administrative cycle always under control

detailedContent.p1: We manage all operational, administrative and registry activities related to customers who use your company's digital services. From creating customer codes to aligning personal records, from collections to refunds to checking invoices, every stage of the customer lifecycle is managed precisely and consistently.
detailedContent.p2: This service is particularly suitable for entities that manage recurring digital services, SaaS platforms, large registry databases, or processes with frequent activations and terminations. Multi-step administrative flows and high-volume billing activities also find structured and reliable support.
detailedContent.p3: The result is an orderly, up-to-date and fully tracked administrative system that eliminates errors and ensures business continuity. The company can thus focus on activities with greater added value, delegating to us the punctual and professional management of the entire administrative cycle.

data-management.name: Data Management
data-management.serviceDescription: Organized and secure management of corporate data, according to cybersecurity and compliance criteria.
data-management.shortDescription: Organized and secure management of corporate data, according to cybersecurity and compliance criteria.
data-management.detailDescription: We manage your data in a secure, organized and compliant manner. From storage to protection, from data quality to integration with business systems.
data-management.functionalitySubtitle: Every Data Management activity is managed with a clear, verifiable and compliant operating model.

functionality.item1: We organize data in an orderly, structured and easily accessible way.
functionality.item2: We apply cybersecurity criteria to protect data from unauthorized access.
functionality.item3: We manage automatic backups and redundant copies to prevent any loss.
functionality.item4: We define roles and permissions, tracking every data access and change.
functionality.item5: We integrate data with CRM, ERP, management and customer platforms.
functionality.item6: We check the quality of the data, correcting inconsistencies and duplicates.

advantages.item1: We apply advanced cybersecurity standards to protect information.
advantages.item2: We keep the data structured, aligned and easily searchable.
advantages.item3: Constant backups and redundant systems to ensure business continuity.
advantages.item4: Data always ready and available for analysis, reporting, and decision-making processes.
advantages.item5: Continuous recovery and monitoring procedures to prevent outages.
advantages.item6: We manage data in compliance with current regulations (GDPR, Data Act, etc.).
advantages.item7: We integrate into your digital systems without operational interruptions.

data-management.detailedContentTitle: A secure, organized and always available data system

detailedContent.p1: Data Management has become a strategic element for any organization that wants to operate with continuity, security and scalability. With our service, we structure, protect and make all business data usable, integrating it into digital processes and ensuring their availability at all times.
detailedContent.p2: We manage the entire data lifecycle by applying advanced cybersecurity and governance criteria. We organize information in an orderly and traceable way, so systems work better and staff can count on reliable and up-to-date databases.
detailedContent.p3: The result is a modern and resilient data infrastructure capable of supporting digital projects, automation and AI-powered initiatives. A safe, scalable environment designed to accompany the company's growth over time.

training-aziendali.name: Corporate Training
training-aziendali.serviceDescription: We offer Corporate Training for end-user groups on complex digital services.
training-aziendali.shortDescription: We offer Corporate Training for end-user groups on complex digital services.
training-aziendali.detailDescription: We design and deliver training activities dedicated to groups of employees who need to use complex digital services. Each session is designed to transfer practical and operational skills.
training-aziendali.functionalitySubtitle: Business training is designed for groups of users who need to understand and use a specific digital service.

functionality.item1: We explain all features of the digital service in a clear and practical way.
functionality.item2: We answer the doubts of the participants live.
functionality.item3: We show the operational flows, from login to daily usage.
functionality.item4: We guide employees in the correct, safe and compliant use of the tool.
functionality.item5: We also delve into parts of the service that not everyone will use, but that are useful to know.
functionality.item6: We can dedicate multiple days or sessions to specific modules, as needed.

item1.title: Customized
item1.description: Tailor-built to business needs, with a focus on critical areas and internal operational flows.

item2.title: Standard
item2.description: Designed to provide a comprehensive overview of the digital service, useful for onboarding and updating.

training-aziendali.detailedContentTitle: Corporate training to improve skills and processes

detailedContent.p1: We offer business training for end-user groups on using the client company's digital services. Training sessions can be modular, multi-session, customized or standard.
detailedContent.p2: They cover all service features, including those not used by all roles, and provide operational instructions, best practices, security procedures and direct support to participants.
detailedContent.p3: The goal is to ensure that the company has competent, autonomous employees who are ready to use the digital service properly, improving productivity, business continuity and security.
